estimate: About 200 hours for the platinum, difficulty about 4/10 (KeenGamer / PowerPyx). No online trophies, no difficulty trophies, no mission medals: it is long, not hard.

stages.text: Play every story mission in order. This earns the 12 story trophies (Gone Fishing, Chapters 1–4, the final mission, and the six named missions) plus the 100% groundwork. At the start of each chapter, make a manual save. In Chapter 1, meditate at Lucia's balcony spot before the chapter ends — it is the missable one.
stages.title: Play the story — Chapters 1 to 5

stages.text: Finish the five named side strands (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) and three more stranger strands to reach 8 total for the silver. Take every stranger icon as it appears on the map; strands stay open after the story, so nothing here can be missed.
stages.title: Side characters & strangers

stages.text: Sweep Leonida area by area: all 52 areas, 100 WAiNK It locations, 100 vehicles discovered, 3 card sets, 18 meditation spots and all 8 garages. These four trophies overlap on the same road trips, so do them together instead of as separate sweeps.
stages.title: Cover the map — collectibles & exploration

stages.text: Work the activity list: 250 stunts, gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, wins in 20 different races and at all 14 drone-race locations, 50 challenges, the fishing win over Cal, one arcade game, bowling, and the partner, robbery and combat feats. Try each activity type once early for Master of None.
stages.title: Activities & grinds

stages.text: Launder $250,000 in Marked Bills through your contacts and spend $100,000 across all shops. Both totals are cumulative, so they should be nearly done by now — top them up with late-game purchases and heist bills. Then check the in-game 100% checklist: whatever is left is your cleanup list, and A Long Road (gold) pops at 100%. The platinum follows at once.
stages.title: Money & cleanup — then 100%

title: Roadmap to the platinum — Vice Got a Price!
warning: Only one trophy is flagged as possibly missable: Positive Mental Attitude. Meditate at every spot the moment you find it, and keep a manual save at the start of every chapter — there is reportedly no mission replay.
